items.active_keyword_firewall: Cross-reference active campaign keywords before adding negative keywords.
items.negative_keyword_readback: Re-query a Google Ads negative-keyword mutation before treating an attempted addition as persisted.
items.brand_search_measurement: Measure brand-search demand as organic and paid brand search together.
items.lost_impression_share: Read Lost Rank and Lost Budget impression share with the account's own bid trajectory, not as standalone competition signals.
items.event_effect_measurement: Use CPM with CPC and click-through rate to distinguish volume events from competition events.
items.marketing_model_safety: Do not treat harness engineering, repeated test runs, or injected instructions as independent marketing evidence.
items.scoring_lift: Require incremental model lift before presenting a CRM dimension as a lead-scoring feature.
items.match_type: Use exact or broad Google Ads match types; do not recommend phrase match.
